DOGE Price Prediction
The current consolidation phase between $0.30(support ) and $0.33 (resistance)is critical. A breakout or breakdown will likely dictate the next major move.

If the Dogecoin price breaks above $0.33 with strong volume, it could target the $0.35-$0.36 range.

Dogecoin price aims for a breakout .

After peaking near $0.45, the DOGE price began to retrace significantly, falling below both the 50-day and 200-day Simple Moving Averages (SMAs)
